summary: First run: full backend + frontend E2E testing of Muhammad Afif portfolio. Backend /api/contact POST/GET + validation and resume PDF all pass. Frontend scrolling (lenis) works via both wheel and nav-link smooth scroll. All 6 projects render, project detail modal opens and closes with all sections present (labels visually uppercased). Contact form correctly shows error toast on empty submit and success toast + POST /api/contact 200 on valid submission. Resume download links point to /resume-muhammad-afif.pdf which is served.

issues: Missing DOM id anchors on <section> elements (#education, #resume). Currently no nav-link targets them so it's not blocking, but adding ids would future-proof deep-linking.

action_items: (Optional) Add id="education" to Education section and id="resume" to ResumeCTA section for consistency with other sections.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is defined AFTER logging.basicConfig and AFTER its first reference inside create_contact_message; works at runtime because getLogger is called at import time, but it is stylistically out of order — move logger init above the endpoint definitions.
server.py imports load_dotenv correctly and uses env vars — good.
MongoDB responses correctly exclude _id via projection {"_id": 0} — good.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_-prefixed contact_messages inserted via POST /api/contact during tests (safe to leave or purge).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_contact_api.py. Lenis smooth-scroll works fine via mouse.wheel AND via nav-link clicks (which invoke lenis.scrollTo). Section ids exist for home/about/work/skills/contact but NOT for education/resume. Project detail labels are visually uppercase (CSS), so when doing text assertions use case-insensitive matching. Contact toast library is sonner; toasts appear in [data-sonner-toast].
